writer_timing: Whole Write2DConcentrations call including output, array clear and dictionary reset; excludes snapshot collection and JSON log.
conversion_timing: Clear of temporary float[][] plus full dictionary enumeration and matching-key transfer, accumulated over calls; timer overhead is present.
counts: ConcurrentDictionary.Count before dispersion and before writer; counts reflect stored keys including any zero-valued entry, not count of nonzero output cells.
occupancy_denominator: SourceGroups.Count * NS * NXL * NYL, separately for central/plus/minus dictionaries.
memory: Snapshots of GC.GetTotalMemory(false), GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(false), GC.CollectionCount(0/1/2), working set and private bytes without forced GC. Allocation and collection deltas are reported for before_dispersion-to-before_writer and before_writer-to-after_writer; allocation estimates include the diagnostic snapshots/logging. Uninstrumented native benchmark is performance authority.
before_dispersion: After flow-field work and prior particle transport for that weather situation.
